concept.reason: Actual museum skeleton photo and primary skull drawing already sufficient.

scope: Complete squirrel-like early euarchont with pointed elongated muzzle and projecting incisors, long furry tail, four clawed limbs. Not a modern monkey or rodent, not a skull-only replacement.

scale.skull_provenance: Boyer and Gingerich2019 Table4 estimated UM87990 cranial length; NOT direct measurement.
scale.body_tail_provenance: Model reconstruction choices guided by skeleton, not published exact live lengths.
scale.2005_figure_scale: Fig1 approximates skull/femur/ulna each9cm; skull superseded for this model by2019 estimated105.83mm. Do not label both direct measured values.

diagnostic_targets: Elongate pointed muzzle with prominent paired incisors at tip; no canine tusks or buck-tooth rodent round head.
Low broad cranial region and relatively lateral eyes, not large front-facing monkey face.
Long furry tapering tail comparable to headbody; gentle trailing curve, not coiled prehensile monkey tail or gliding membrane.
Four distinct limbs with long curved terminal claws and separated digits; no human palms, opposable-thumb grasp or flat primate nails.
Trunk depth and squat robust climbing stance with hindlimbs recognizable; preserve all limbs and tail in four views.
Muted brown coat is interpretive; no claim of preserved pigmentation or hair contour.
uncertainties: Mounted UM87990 includes reconstructed light-gray parts. Do not treat mount pose as fossil life pose.
2019 describes17preserved caudals and at least3missing anterior; total tail proportions reconstructed.
Some associated metacarpals may be Uintacyon; avoid falsely exact finger proportions.
Ear shape, fur density/color, soft body depth and pose inferred.
Plesiadapiform phylogenetic position not a modern crown monkey.
acceptance: Full original animal retained: elongate incisor muzzle and long squirrel-like tail both readable.
Clawed limbs not modern grasping monkey hands; no gliding membranes.
ExactGLB four views, self-contained two reproducible builds and independent QA.
